content: Yɛsu kan'kɔɔr ŋun'kyal mwɛy ilä a saba
Yàmɛnà naa ilä a saba mwɛy mfum a Amfarisi mwɛy kàbel Yɛsu mukàdyà u ndwà ande. Baar bàkäl paa bàkäl musey nde ubwaŋàbwaŋ.
Wɛɛ le, mbuur aŋàyàyam u ndür kàkäl aŋàmbar kusà a nde.
Yɛsu kàsi ndaa, waa kàtɛn a alɔɔŋ a in'kɔɔn anà Amfarisi naa: « Nkye bàkyàpà mbwo lɛɛ tɛy mukɔɔr mbuur ilä a saba? »
Wɛɛ ba ndaa bàsi anki. Apan Yɛsu laa kàbä nde mbuur awun, waa kun'kɔɔr, kun'sweŋ mufurà ndwà ande.
Ungö apan, nde waa kàtɛn a ba naa: « Nà uboo abɛ, isàkal naa mwan ande itàkal ngɔɔmà ande kan'bwà uboo a fu, mpa kun'twey nde a agyägyä, ilä a saba? »
Wɛɛ ba sye bàsàkwo anki mufuur.
An'lwɛŋ ntɔn làbɔ̈ɔ̈n anà nkyeer a ndaa aŋàbwaŋ
Mpal kàmɛn nde naa baar bàbel bàkäl musɔɔl ikal atàtwɛb, nde kàtɛ nsim yi:
« Isàkal naa mbuur kàmabel mukàdyà ilä atà bör ande, twon an'kàbwaay kà ikal a imfum. Taaŋ lumwɛy uboo abɛ we anà mbuur kan'söön ngye unsà imfum
anà mbuur kàlabel, ngye anà nde, uyàtɛn a ngye naa: "Sun'wɛy ikal ki." Uboo a nswɛn, ngye akàbwaay kà ikal a ngöngö.

Wɛɛ, manà bàmabel, kyen kabwaay kà ikal a ngöngö. Abun, mpal uyàbilà mbuur kabel, nde waa kakyään naa: "Un'sam amɛ, kye anà ikal aŋasöön ubwaŋ ntɔn ngye, yabwaay udu kà". Abun ngye ayàkal aŋasyäŋà u mii a baar bàkäl anà ngye u mɛsà.
Lalan, mbuur afàsɛɛn an'pɛy bàkyer afun'tyeey, mbuur afàtyà bàkyer afun'sɛn. »

Ungö Yɛsu waa kàtɛn a mbuur kun'bel naa: « Isàkal naa ngye apà baar udyà, twon an'bel asam angye, atɔŋ angye, baar a mbil angye, itàkal aŋun'naaŋ bàfàkal tsütsü apà ngye, ntɔn ba sye bàfàsabel mufuur ayi yanswà an'kyer ngye.
Wɛɛ, isàkal naa ngye apà isaa akà baar, bel aŋàlàmbwà, baar aŋàyɔm in'kɔl, ikar, ikwàmii.
Waa ngye ayàkal kà un'sak ntɔn baar aban ndöŋ yatɛy musafuur asànaa an'kyer ngye. Waa Nzam usakwɛy mpal bàsàwiyà baar a balàbal kà ukwà. »
Nsim a udyà a kölàköl
Yàmɛnà naa ungö apan, umwɛy uboo a baar bàbel waa kàtɛn a Yɛsu naa: « Un'sak akà mbuur asàwal ikal mpal bàsàdii baar uboo a Imwol a Nzam! »
Waa Yɛsu kun'fuur naa: « Ilä mwɛy, mbuur mwɛy kàwɛl baar u ndwà ande ntɔn udyà a kölàköl. Waa nde kàbel baar mbɔɔn.
Taaŋ a udyà làkwe la, nde kàtöm un'syääl ande mukàswaŋ baar kàbel nde naa: "Làyi apanà, ntɔn ndaa yanswà yan'kwo."
Wɛ ba banswà bàkal mun umwɛy wa, waa bàlɔ̈m ndwääl a nkul. Wàtàtwɛb kun'kyään naa: "Mɛ an'som ywanŋ làmwɛy, mɛ in'kyer akyà mukàler la. Mɛ amabɔɔn, ndwääl nkul."
Wumwɛy naa: "Mɛ an'som adim atyeen anà akyay atyeen bà ngɔɔmà. Mɛ in'kyer akàsi ya. Mɛ amabɔɔn, ndwääl nkul."
Wumwɛy sye naa: "Mɛ an'bääl làbenàben alà, mɛ in'kwe anki muyà."

Taaŋ kàyàfurà un'syääl awun, nde kàkyään nkum ande ndaa ayi yanswà bàtɛn ba. Lalan ŋandwà kàwem nde nkyɛl, kàswɛŋ nde un'syääl ande naa: "Kyen agyägyä! Kyen u mbay anà kan'balàbal a bul, twaal pabà aŋàlàmbwà, baar aŋàkwɛkà, ikwàmii, ikar."
Ungö a taaŋ, un'syääl waa kàyàkyään nkum ande naa: "Mwol, mɛ an'kyer asànaa an'swɛŋ ngye, wɛɛ ikal a ipɔl byà paa."
Nkum ande naa: "Kyen u mbwo yanswà, u mbil a mpaŋ, siinà baar bàbilà, ntɔn ndwà amɛ iyöl abar.
Wɛɛ mɛ, mɛ alàkyään ndandaa naa akà mbuur mwɛy uboo a baar kàbel mɛ ulɛr anki isaa amɛ!" »
Ndaa a mfun mukal un'lɔŋki
Yàmɛnà naa mbul a baar kàyikyeenà a Yɛsu, nde waa kàbulà, waa kàtɛn a ba naa:
« Isàkal naa mbuur an'yà akà mɛ, wɛɛ nde udiimà anki taarànde, ngwän, un'kyay ande, baan ande, atɔŋ ande babaal anà bakaar, itàkal ndür ande ŋakwo, nde ukwe anki mukal un'lɔŋki amɛ.
Mbuur mpa usɛn buur ande anà mpa ulab mɛ, nde ukwe anki mukal un'lɔŋki amɛ.
Abà, nà uboo abɛ akwen mutɔŋ ndwà a bwɛlàbwɛl, nde uwal anki taaŋ muyweer ntɔn muyöb naa nde kwe uyàtwey, nkye nde ayàkwo mumay ndwà ande?
Naa tɛy, nde uyàmay anki mutɔŋ ungö musà un'bään, baar banswà bàsamanà ya bàkyer asun'sɛ.
Ba bàsàtɛn naa: "Làler mbuur kàsɛmà mutɔŋ, wɛ nde kàkwe anki mumay."

Itàkal naa mfum mwɛy wà tsütsü muleŋ ngwiy a mfum asin. Nde uwal anki taaŋ mubwaay anà muyweer naa nkye nde akyàkwo muwal iböŋ kusà a mbuur awe abà baar nsaab an'kwem mööl isàkal naa nde ŋakwo we abà baar nsaab kwem?
Nde usàman naa nde ukwo anki, nde atɔm in'kyeey mpal awà un'yiiŋ ande u kwɛlàkwɛl ntɔn muyöŋà duu.
Ya ye abun sye ntɔn bɛ: uboo abɛ, mbuur mpa ukwen mukɔɔb ubwaŋ ande banswà ukwe anki mukal un'lɔŋki amɛ. »
Muŋ akɔ̈ɔ̈n ntsà
« Muŋ wà undiir aŋàbwaŋ, wɛɛ ntsà awa isàwà, ya bàyun'fuur a nkye?
Wa bàfàsàsyääl anki itàkal ntɔn mɛɛn, itàkal ntɔn mudii ndon. Undiir kan'saal: upiy wa bwà u nsà. Wɛy mbuur awe anà an'tsü awem uwem. »
